mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.phone, u.email, u.password, u.real_name, u.id_num, u.status, tm.status AS member_status, tm.enterprise_id, ss.status AS subscription_status, ss.suspend_reason AS subscription_suspend_reason, u.updated_by, u.deleted AS is_delete FROM tenant_user u LEFT JOIN tenant_member tm ON tm.user_id = u.id AND tm.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN saas_subscription ss ON ss.enterprise_id = tm.enterprise_id WHERE LOWER(TRIM(u.email)) = #{username} AND u.deleted = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tenant_user identity_user WHERE identity_user.deleted=0 AND LOWER(TRIM(identity_user.email))=#{username})=1 ORDER BY tm.status DESC, tm.id LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.phone, u.email, u.password, u.real_name, u.id_num, u.status, tm.status AS member_status, tm.enterprise_id, ss.status AS subscription_status, ss.suspend_reason AS subscription_suspend_reason, u.updated_by, u.deleted AS is_delete FROM tenant_user u LEFT JOIN tenant_member tm ON tm.user_id = u.id AND tm.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN saas_subscription ss ON ss.enterprise_id = tm.enterprise_id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.deleted = 0 ORDER BY tm.status DESC, tm.id LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM tenant_member WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.phone, u.email, u.password, u.real_name, u.id_num, u.status, tm.status AS member_status, tm.enterprise_id, ss.status AS subscription_status, ss.suspend_reason AS subscription_suspend_reason, u.updated_by, u.deleted AS is_delete FROM tenant_user u JOIN tenant_member tm ON tm.user_id = u.id AND tm.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND tm.deleted = 0 JOIN tenant_enterprise te ON te.id = tm.enterprise_id AND te.status = 1 AND te.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN saas_subscription ss ON ss.enterprise_id = tm.enterprise_id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: u.id, u.real_name AS name, u.username, u.email, u.id_num, r.id AS role_id, r.name AS role_name, u.status, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(u.created_at) AS create_time
FROM tenant_user u JOIN tenant_member tm ON tm.user_id = u.id AND tm.deleted = 0 JOIN auth_role r ON r.code = tm.role_code AND r.role_scope = 'TENANT' AND r.deleted = 0

SELECT WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND tm.status = 2 AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{blurParam}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{blurParam}, '%')) AND r.id = #{roleId}

SELECT u.id, u.real_name, u.username, u.email, u.id_num, u.status
WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 AND tm.status = 1 AND tm.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{blurParam}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{blurParam}, '%') OR u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{blurParam}, '%'))
ORDER BY u.id ASC LIMIT 50
